cloud_height_compat.options.enabled.tool: Corrects shader clouds and cloud shadows in expanded dimensions. Disable to restore the shader's original height.
cloud_height_compat.options.manual.toolt: Off by default to preserve automatic height correction. Enable to use the cloud base Y coordinate selected below. Per-dimension overrides in the config file take priority.
cloud_height_compat.options.height.toolt: Drag to set the cloud base Y coordinate. Default: 832. Focus the slider and use the left/right arrow keys for 1-block adjustments. Apply saves and updates clouds without reloading shaders. Remove any override for the current dimension to use this slider.
